title: Session Recorder
subtitle: Opens a record when a session starts, captures the questions asked and the answers given, tracks which model was used, and writes a summary when the session ends.
lede: Opens a record when a session starts, captures the questions asked and the answers given, tracks which model was used, and writes a summary when the session ends. Each session's history can then be browsed.
who: A team lead who wants a record of each AI-assisted working session
author: Corey James
